eventDetail.sponsors: IEEE Power & Energy Society; Kadir Has University
eventDetail.keywords: power systems,renewable energy,Smart grid technologies and applications,Grid integration of renewable energy sources,Low-carbon buildings and communities: renewables, HVAC systems and energy efficiency,Novel energy conversion and energy storage,Policy, regulation, and financing,Cybersecurity and data management,Community engagement adhering to social science and humanity principles,
eventDetail.scope: SyNERGY MED is a multidisciplinary conference focusing on the energy transition in the Mediterranean region. It welcomes research on:  Renewable energy technologies and integration  Smart grid architectures and energy storage systems  Cybersecurity, data analytics, and digital infrastructures (e.g., for SCADA and microgrids)  Policies, regulations, and financing mechanisms advancing low-carbon energy deployment  Socio-economic impacts of smart energy systems, energy-efficient buildings, and sustainable communities
